## Philips N4520 Player v0.0.13

### Changed
- Reworked reel motion to use phase-preserving Web Animations instead of per-frame JavaScript transform writes.
- Preserved reel animation phase when tape-pack driven reel speed changes are large enough to require a new animation duration.
- Included the current standalone prototype VU meter calibration and sample image updates.
- Added the current session handoff note to the repository.

### Validation
- Passed JavaScript syntax checks for the app and HACS card bundle.
- Verified the HACS card source and distributed bundle match.
- Browser-tested the card with jittery media-position updates; reel animations were not recreated and no backward reel samples were observed.
